questions.q: What are the four documented steps in OrderTotal's lineage, in order?
options: Atlas calculation, nightly load to Summit staging, curated transformation into fact_Orders, Power BI dashboard refresh
Power BI, Atlas, Harbor, Comet
Beacon, Comet, Atlas, Summit, in no particular order
A single manual spreadsheet export, with no other steps
questions.explain: The lesson documents exactly these four named steps, each with a system and a trigger, from order completion to the executive dashboard.

questions.q: What is the purpose of running an impact analysis on a lineage map, per this lesson?
options: To determine what breaks downstream before a proposed change is made, so the right people can be warned in advance
To delete the lineage map once a year
To rename every table in the pipeline
Impact analysis has no practical purpose beyond documentation
questions.explain: The lesson frames impact analysis as walking the map backward from a proposed change to find every downstream step that needs to know about it first.

questions.q: In the hypothetical currency-conversion scenario, which three downstream steps would be affected if nobody was told?
options: The nightly load, the curated transformation, and the Power BI dashboard
Only the Power BI dashboard, nothing else
Only Beacon and Comet, which are unrelated to OrderTotal
No downstream steps would be affected
questions.explain: The lesson walks through exactly these three steps needing updates or clarification if a currency conversion were silently added upstream in Atlas.

questions.q: Why does this lesson deliberately avoid documenting a clean lineage for 'Customer'?
options: Because three unreconciled source copies exist with no declared authoritative source, so a diagram today would just formalize the existing confusion
Because Customer data does not exist anywhere at LTV Global
Because lineage documentation is never useful for customer data
Because Dana Whitfield forbade any further work on Customer data
questions.explain: The lesson explains that Customer lineage has to wait for Lesson 9's authoritative-source decision before it can be documented meaningfully.

questions.q: What does the Summit 'curated layer' do in OrderTotal's lineage, per this lesson?
options: It applies the Lesson 7 quality rules as a filter and produces the conformed fact_Orders table
It is where Power BI directly stores its dashboard visuals
It is the original source of OrderTotal, before Atlas
It has no defined role in the lineage
questions.explain: Step 3 of the lineage explicitly describes the curated layer applying the earlier quality rules before marking rows as curated in fact_Orders.
